_why: XbSymbolDatabase does not cover XMV, the video library, so these
addresses had no names and could not be replaced by name.
scripts/section_calls.py finds seven calls crossing into the XMV section
(0x00145D40..0x0016DB0C). Create, Destroy and GetStreamInfo sit at the
same offsets into the section as Future Perfect's and Breakdown's (+0x10D,
+0x651, +0x735); the rest are named from how the movie code at
0x000C7E60..0x000C83B0 calls them. There is no Start: the first Update

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackGetAudioStreamInfo
symbols._note: 0x00146491. From 0x000C7E9B: (handle, index, &info); the caller checks the codec for 0x69 and the channels for 2.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackCreateAudioStream
symbols._note: 0x00146529. From 0x000C7ED0's set-up, once per audio stream.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackUpdate
symbols._note: 0x001466A8. From 0x000C8256 in the per-frame loop: (handle, surface, &status, &time), both outputs zeroed first.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackGetCurrentTime
symbols._note: 0x00146D25. From 0x000C82A6, with the handle, straight after each Update, as Breakdown's.
